title: Themes: overview film
description: 15 presets, switched in the site settings. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 53 seconds: the 15 theme presets of Desiderio for TYPO3 v14 on the same pages, in light and dark mode. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: On most sites, a new brand colour means new templates, new CSS and a round of testing.
Desiderio ships 15 theme presets. One setting changes the look of every page.
Each preset sets colours, fonts and corner radius together, on the same content.
Every preset has a dark mode, and visitors switch it from the header.
Pricing tables, dashboards and forms follow the same design tokens, with no template change.
Start with one of the 15 presets, or design your own.
